summary.text: Liz Larson is a Democratic state senator from South Dakota Senate District 10 who assumed office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, when she faces Republican Michael Dupic.
She holds a master's degree in international studies from the University of Oregon.

paragraphs.text: Elizabeth "Liz" Larson earned a bachelor's degree in international development and environmental studies from The Evergreen State College and a master's degree in international studies from the University of Oregon.

She also earned a certificate in documentary photography from the Salt Institute for Documentary Studies and a certificate in digital money, banking, and financial support services from The Fletcher School at Tufts University.
Larson assumed office in the South Dakota State Senate on January 10, 2023, succeeding Republican Margaret Sutton.

In the 2025-2026 session she is assigned to the Senate Commerce and Energy Committee, the Senate State Affairs Committee, and the Senate Transportation Committee, and is vice chair of the Senate Select Committee on the Nomination for Lieutenant Governor.
